biggest_catch: PlaytestCloud publishes no official general payout — every reward is stated on the individual playtest invite, so the concrete-payout requirement fails on official terms alone.
catches: No official published pay range; the reward amount appears only on each playtest invite.
Payment arrives up to 3 days after a well-completed playtest via Tremendous — days, not today.
The unpaid qualification test is required before any paid playtests.
Test volume varies by profile match; first-come, first-served.

c1.evidence: Official PlaytestCloud Tester FAQ describes the reward process and payment provider.

c2.evidence: No concrete payout in official terms: 'The reward amount for each playtest can be found on your playtest invite.'

c3.evidence: Official FAQ: 'As long as you have completed a playtest well, you can expect to receive the payment in up to 3 days.' Paid via Tremendous (PayPal, gift cards, virtual cards).

c4.evidence: Free to join; no fee in official FAQ.

eligibility: Tester panel signup; unpaid qualification test; playtests matched to profile; first-come, first-served
maximize: Not verifiable as a route — no general pay range published. Only claim playtests whose invite-listed reward you would accept; complete them fast since slots go first-come, first-served.
notes: Official timing is fast (up to 3 days via Tremendous), but without an official published payout range or session length this cannot be a verified route. Third-party pay claims (~$9 per 15-minute playtest) were excluded.

s1.note: Cannot fully assess — payout missing from official terms.

s2.note: Timing officially stated (up to 3 days via Tremendous), but payout is missing so the route still fails.

s3.note: Eligibility = tester panel signup plus qualification test — stated on official FAQ.

s5.note: Flow documented officially, but no pay terms attached.

s6.note: No official general pay conditions published.

s7.note: No official statement of per-person playtest volume.

timing: Payment via Tremendous (PayPal, gift cards, virtual bank cards) within up to 3 days of a well-completed playtest.
